name: forge
description: Spec-first development skills with structured spec authoring, validation, maintained Spec Pages, request-only Review Viewer output, cross-agent authoring, verification, debugging, and interface design. Produces adapters for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-first process skills for real projects.
interface.longDescription: Forge packages a complete spec-first workflow - structured spec authoring and validation, maintained Spec Pages, planning, execution, and verified implementation - plus one-source authoring for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity skills and MCP configurations, browser application design, website design, tone overlays, systematic debugging, and TDD. Specs and plans remain source of truth; Spec Pages stay synchronized with spec changes, while Review Viewer HTML is generated only on explicit request.
defaultPrompt: Write a spec for this feature before we code.
Create one skill and MCP bundle for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity.
Use web-app-design to improve this dashboard settings workflow.
Use website-design to create this public product landing page.
Validate this structured spec and update its maintained Spec Page.
Create a Review Viewer for this spec only for this review request.
